evidence.title: Raylight: Build beautiful product videos in minutes

name: Raylight
summary: Browser studio for making product launch and demo videos from screenshots: design shots on a canvas, animate on a timeline, export MP4.
description: Web app that turns screenshots, shapes and footage into product launch videos. Lay out shots on a canvas, add animation blocks on the timeline, use 3D device mockups, camera moves and scene effects, then export MP4 or GIF. Templates are remixable; an MCP server lets Claude, Codex and Cursor drive edits; voiceover, music and sound effects are generated. Free plan plus Hobby, Pro and Max tiers.
contains: free plan: unlimited projects and 1080p exports with a badge
remixable video templates (Apple News+ remake used 4385 times)
MCP server for Claude, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity
3D device mockups for iPhone, iPad and MacBook
voiceover, music and sound effects with credits
